en.headline: Free unlimited tram rides on Hong Kong Island today
en.dek: UnionPay International is offering unlimited free travel on all Hong Kong Tramways services on Thursday as part of a promotion tied to its lucky draw campaign.
body: Passengers can ride Hong Kong Tramways services free of charge and without limit on Thursday, 17 September, under a one-day promotion organised by UnionPay International.

The operator said the free-ride day, themed around exploring the city, applies to regular tram services across Hong Kong Island. Riders are still expected to board and alight as usual; no ticket or special voucher is required.

UnionPay International said the event also marks the start of its lucky-draw campaign. Separately, the company is running other transport discounts for cardholders on certain days, including reduced fares on selected buses and ferries at weekends.

zh.headline: 今日港島電車全日免費任坐
zh.dek: 銀聯國際周四舉辦電車免費乘車日，市民及旅客可無限次免費乘搭港島電車，活動同時為其抽獎盛典揭幕。
body: 銀聯國際今日（9月17日）舉辦「電車免費乘車日」，所有乘客可全日無限次免費乘搭香港電車，暢遊港島。
活動適用於港島電車常規服務，乘客如常上車落車，無需特別票券或證明。
銀聯國際表示，是次活動以探索城市為主題，並為「銀聯幸運抽獎大盛典」揭開序幕。該公司另有其他交通優惠，包括周末指定車船車費折扣等。
